l.i: Quę pius Hermannus fatali carmine luget,
Addit & extinctas ranam tremulámque lacertá,
Funera Natura fluido tumulata liquore,
Magnanimi mortem quæ portendisse futuram
Principis affirmat,qui Dacica regna tenebat.
Iudicij laudo subtile ingentis acumen,
Vatis & agnosco venam ingeniúmque diserti.
Fallit in hoc tamen Hermannus,& fallitur ipse,
Quòd putat hæc tanti prænuncia funeris esse
Funera.Nam rana nihil immundaq; lacertá
Cum magno commune Duce est,nec vidit ab aui
Principiis quisquam,nec tale audiuit in orbe
Ominis exemplum:ranas obiisse loquaces
Cum magni cecidere Duces. At nobile,dices,
Ipsa quod extinctis fecit Natura sepulchrum,
Nomina ranarum reddit meliora,suóque
Eximit e numero,& rariś animalibus æquat.
Vt sit nobilior Naphtá velamine tecta
Rana,tamen rana est,& Simia,Simia certè est,
Purpureo quamuis circumfundatur amictu.
Necsi asinum inuoluas gemmis,aurívé metalla,
Desinet esse asinus,nec aue mihi Coggyga quisquam
Gemmata efficiet cauea ne Coggyga dicam.

page.notes: Verse lines are printed as separate lines; each stanza-like run is given here as one paragraph because the printer set it as a continuous poem. Line-final "quisqua" is printed with a tilde/mark that may be a superscript abbreviation; read as "quisquam" with [?] advised. "Necsi" and "Coggyga" are as printed. The signature at the foot is read as "N. iiij" with [?] advised, since the final letter is partly obscured.
